climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Pennsylvania AVA of 1.2 million acres, a long valley between Second Mountain to the north and South Mountain to the south, running from Jim Thorpe to Easton. Pennsylvania's most planted grapes are Catawba, Chambourcin, Cabernet Franc and Chardonnay.
